properties.description: A record that moved ahead of this seat is reported, and one that has not is silent. COVERS: the three consumption-free states (in_step / moved_but_current / behind) and the two fault states (missing / unreadable); that ordinary unexported work is NEVER reported, which is the property the whole design rests on; that two targets are independent and neither hides the other; that every known target is listed so an empty answer cannot read as all-clear; that the finding names both `import_graph` and the path and never reads as a refusal (no "refused"/"error"/"cannot"/"blocked"); that the expensive export is NOT built on the in-step path and is built exactly once when needed; and THE REGRESSION THAT MATTERS MOST — a record edited without restamping is still caught, because the check computes the content hash instead of believing the one the document states about itself. NOT COVERED: the live MCP surface end-to-end (the served tool was exercised against a scratch graph via the CLI, not against a running server), and any behaviour of `import_graph` itself.
properties.findings: That last case was found end-to-end rather than by any unit test, after the first cut shipped believing the stamp and reported "in step" while somebody else's work sat in the file.
